dsers_email.title: DSers Email
dsers_email.description: DSers account email address used for authentication

default_country.title: Default Country
default_country.description: Default target country code for shipping and pricing (e.g. US, GB, DE). Applied when country is not specified per-import.

default_store.title: Default Store
default_store.description: Default target store name. Skips store selection when pushing to one store. Use the display_name from dsers.store.discover.

default_visibility.title: Default Visibility
default_visibility.description: Default product visibility: backend_only (draft) or sell_immediately (published)

price_multiplier.title: Default Price Multiplier
price_multiplier.description: Default pricing multiplier for all imports when no per-import pricing rule is set (e.g. 2.0 for 2x markup)
